summary: Bloomberg: Sources: Anthropic has walked away from talks to acquire Decart for ~$6B after performing due diligence on the startup — Anthropic PBC has decided against acquiring artificial intelligence startup Decart AI, people familiar with the matter said. — Anthropic had been exploring a deal …
contentText:
Bloomberg :

Sources: Anthropic has walked away from talks to acquire Decart for ~$6B after performing due diligence on the startup   —  Anthropic PBC has decided against acquiring artificial intelligence startup Decart AI, people familiar with the matter said.  —  Anthropic had been exploring a deal …
